purpose: Teach: 水路/電線/イスラーム/清浄/農法/明瞭/新約/精製

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、伝統水路、つまり水路灌漑の地理研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you covered a geography study of traditional waterways — canal irrigation — in your paper, didn't you.
lines.style: Calm, welcoming teacher's opening. Unhurried pace, an encouraging settle on the confirmation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、電線、つまり電線地中化の都市工学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I did an urban-engineering study on power lines, on burying them underground.
lines.style: Best-behavior energy with teen speed underneath. Quick start, a proud little emphasis on underground.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: イスラーム、つまりイスラーム圏の社会研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And social research on the Islamic world — you took that up as well.
lines.style: Thoughtful, appraising tone, a touch slower. Interest warming the topic as she names it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、清浄、つまり清浄空間の建築学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote on architectural research into clean spaces, into really pure environments.
lines.style: Faster now, riding a small wave of confidence. A slight grin audible on the emphasis.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 有機農法、つまり農法の比較研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also handled a comparative study of organic farming methods, didn't you.
lines.style: Even checklist calm with a proud undertone. Gentle rise inviting her to continue.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、論理の明瞭さを評価する哲学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I did a philosophy study on how clear an argument's logic is.
lines.style: Trying to sound scholarly, mostly succeeding. Careful pacing, a tiny triumphant lift at the end.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 新約聖書の文献研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And the textual study of the New Testament — that was yours too.
lines.style: Softly impressed, pace easing, the question nearly flattened into quiet praise.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、石油精製、つまり精製プロセスの工学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I did an engineering study of oil refining, the whole refinement process.
lines.style: Finishing strong, quick and bright. A satisfied exhale tucked behind the last word.
